title: slice-executor-mid has no co-work refusal clause
reason: The Codex .toml executors stated the design gate in both tiers, but the Claude .md executors state it only in slice-executor-high. A mid executor handed a co-work slice has no written instruction to refuse it. Pre-existing, surfaced by P15.S4 while porting Test 0's executor invariants; out of scope for the drop-Codex phase.
trigger: Next time .claude/agents/slice-executor-*.md are edited, or if a co-work slice is ever mis-routed to mid
